content: While a Time Base Timeout is present ( TIMEOUT bit is set in Time Base synchronization status timeBaseStatus ), CanTSyn shall discard SYNC/FUP (or OFS/OFNS) messages until it has successfully validated (refer to [SWS_CanTSyn_00078]) n consecutive SYNC/FUP (or OFS/OFNS) message pairs ( n is given by the parameter CanTSynGlobalTimeSequenceCounterHysteresis ).
